name: Crystal Crop Protection
summary: Crystal Crop Protection, founded in 1994, sells herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, plant growth regulators and seeds in India through more than 13,000 distributors and exports selected products. In the RHP, revenue from operations rose 17.2% to ₹3,152 cr in FY26 and profit after tax rose 22.4% to ₹144.9 cr, though return on equity stayed below 8%. At the upper band the company is valued at about ₹4,438 cr, or about 30.6x FY26 profit, below the median of its listed agrochemical peers. Of the ₹354.8 cr fresh issue, ₹270 cr (about 76%) goes to repaying debt of the company and its subsidiary Saffire Crop Science, and the ₹100.7 cr offer for sale is by promoter Ankur Aggarwal.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹2,230 cr in FY24 to ₹3,152 cr in FY26, a CAGR of about 18.9%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew in both of the last 2 years: about 20.7% in FY25 and 17.2% in FY26 to ₹3,152 cr.

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.40 at March 2026 (borrowings ₹820 cr vs net worth ₹2,040 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 42% (₹577 cr to ₹820 cr) over FY24–FY26, slightly faster than revenue (about 41%).

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹1,488 cr (FY24), ₹1,600 cr (FY25) and ₹2,040 cr (FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Profit growth

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: PAT margin improved from about 3.9% (FY24) to 4.4% (FY25) and 4.6% (FY26).
